evals.prompt: Create a project specification document for a small order-tracking REST service written in Go. Cover goals, non-goals, glossary, functional requirements, and design decisions.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown project document with a version comment, glossary table, requirement ID tables, and the skill's sentence-per-line style.
expectations: The document contains a version HTML comment directly below the H1.
Requirements are presented in tables with identifier columns.
Every table is aligned by source-text width with separator width equal to column width plus two hyphens.
Prose uses one sentence per paragraph and straight ASCII quotes.

evals.prompt: Napisz krótki artykuł po polsku o tym, czym jest bufor cykliczny, z przykładem użycia w systemie wbudowanym.
evals.expected_output: A Polish article with sentence-case headings, correct diacritics, and narrative paragraphs.
expectations: Section headings use sentence case, not Title Case.
All Polish diacritics are preserved and written in composed form.
The document contains no typographic quotes and no semicolons in prose.
Tables, if present, are source-width aligned.

evals.prompt: Edit the supplied existing project document that uses numbered chapters (# 1, ## 1.1): add a new functional requirement and a new use case in the middle of the document.
evals.expected_output: An in-place edit that preserves numbered chapters, the document's encoding, and its table conventions with a minimal diff.
expectations: Section numbering stays continuous and correct after the insertion.
No unrelated section was reformatted or reworded.
New table rows follow the document's existing table style and padding.
The file's original encoding and line-ending style are preserved.

evals.prompt: Fix the formatting of the misaligned Markdown tables in this document so they are readable as plain text.
evals.expected_output: The same document with every table compacted and pipe-aligned by source width.
expectations: All pipes in each table column align vertically in plain-text view.
Column widths were measured on source text including backticks and emphasis markers.
Each separator row is column width plus two hyphens.
No table content was shortened or changed.

evals.prompt: Zapisz szybką notatkę z planowania: trzy punkty do omówienia i dwie pozycje otwarte.
evals.expected_output: A minimal Polish note, possibly without an H1, with informal list structure.
expectations: The note stays minimal - no forced template sections.
Task items use the - [ ] syntax.
Polish diacritics are preserved.

evals.prompt: Update two paragraphs in this legacy document that is stored in CP1250 encoding with CRLF line endings.
evals.expected_output: An edit that detects and preserves the CP1250 encoding and CRLF line endings.
expectations: The file remains in CP1250 after the edit.
Line endings remain CRLF.
The agent ran encoding detection before writing.

evals.prompt: Add a new topic page documenting the retry helpers to this Sphinx documentation project.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case Markdown page in docs/source/, written in the dominant dialect of the surrounding pages, with a new entry added to the index.rst toctree.
expectations: The agent detected the sphinx-docs scope before writing.
The new page filename is lowercase kebab-case.
The page heading style matches the dominant dialect of the neighboring pages.
The page is registered as a toctree entry in index.rst without other changes to that file.
No unrelated files were modified.

evals.prompt: Add a new rule file covering glossary conventions to this agent skill repository and register it.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case rule file in the correct directory, registered in SKILL.md under the matching directory section, with Contents and README kept in sync.
expectations: The agent detected the agent-skill scope before writing.
The new file follows the target directory's naming convention.
SKILL.md gained a registration line saying what the file covers and when to load it.
Affected Contents tables and the README directory tree were updated.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this directory that has no documentation structure.
evals.expected_output: A standalone README.md written to the location named by the request, with no registration or index updates performed.
expectations: The agent reported the unstructured-layout scope.
The agent resolved the README type as readme-general or asked which README variant applies.
No index, router, or registry file was created or modified.
The filename follows the language file naming rules or a type-conventional name.

evals.prompt: Write an implementation plan for the new retry feature in this guided project.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case plan document placed in docs/plan/<current-version>/ with an -implementation suffix, carrying the project's version comment convention.
expectations: The agent detected the guided-project scope and read the project's guidelines document first.
The plan file sits in docs/plan/ under the current version directory.
The filename is kebab-case with the -implementation suffix.
The document carries the project's version-comment convention.
No version number was bumped.

evals.prompt: Add a new engineering standard for Kotlin development to this documentation repository.
evals.expected_output: A rules-voice standard document at docs/standard/kotlin-development.md, following the repository's own style documents.
expectations: The agent detected the docs-collection scope.
The new file is named docs/standard/kotlin-development.md.
The document follows the shape of the neighboring standard documents.
No governing rule file was modified.

evals.prompt: Document the import pipeline in the converter subproject of this multi-project repository.
evals.expected_output: A document inside converter/docs/ that follows that subproject's own conventions, with no root-level or sibling-project files touched.
expectations: The agent resolved the scope per directory and applied the subproject's nearest governing documents.
The new document sits inside the converter subproject's docs tree.
Conventions were not mixed across project boundaries.
No files outside the target subproject were modified.

evals.prompt: Discover the document layout of this repository.
evals.expected_output: An inline layout report naming the best-matching scope with its signal basis, matched and missing signals per candidate, document-type classification, and exceptions.
expectations: The agent ran the scope signal census tool on the target directory.
The verdict names a scope and whether the match is full, partial, or closest.
Matched and missing signals are listed for the candidate scopes.
Exceptions and documents no scope covers are reported, not hidden.
No file was created or modified in the analyzed location.

evals.prompt: Wykryj układ dokumentów w tym katalogu.
evals.expected_output: An inline Polish layout report naming the best-matching scope or the unstructured fallback, with signals and exceptions.
expectations: The report is delivered in Polish, matching the request language.
The agent ran the scope signal census on the target directory.
The verdict names a scope with its basis, or unstructured-layout when nothing matches.
Exceptions and unclassified documents are reported.
The report is inline - no file was written.

evals.prompt: Write an ADR in this repository deciding to use a Postgres-backed queue instead of RabbitMQ for the event pipeline. The docs/adr/ directory already holds records 0001 through 0007.
evals.expected_output: A new decision record at docs/adr/0008-postgres-queue.md with a status block, context, decision drivers, both options, and consequences, written in the skill's sentence-per-line style.
expectations: The new record filename is NNNN-kebab-case-title.md with NNNN being the next free number after the existing records.
A status metadata list sits directly below the H1 with Status set to proposed.
The record covers exactly one decision, with both options and their trade-offs.
No existing ADR file was modified.

evals.prompt: Supersede the accepted ADR-0003 in docs/adr/ with a new decision that reverses it.
evals.expected_output: A new numbered ADR recording the reversing decision, plus a single-line status change on ADR-0003 marking it superseded by the new record.
expectations: A new record was created with the next free number instead of editing the old record's body.
The old record changed only its Status line to superseded by the new ADR number.
The old record's decision body, context, and options were left untouched.
The new record links back to the record it supersedes.

evals.prompt: Draft an RFC for adding multi-tenant support to this service, with alternatives and open questions.
evals.expected_output: A proposal document with a metadata block, summary, background, proposal, alternatives with rejection reasons, risks, open questions marked TBD, and a Decision section marked NOT SPECIFIED.
expectations: A metadata block with Status, Author, and dates sits directly below the H1.
Every unresolved point in Open Questions is marked TBD with an owner.
The Decision section reads NOT SPECIFIED, not an invented resolution.
Each alternative states its rejection reason in one sentence.

evals.prompt: Add a page documenting the retry helpers to this MkDocs project.
evals.expected_output: A kebab-case Markdown page in docs/, plus a nav entry added to mkdocs.yml in the correct section, with no other changes to the configuration file.
expectations: The agent detected the mkdocs-site scope before writing.
The new page filename is lowercase kebab-case.
The page path was added to the nav list in mkdocs.yml when a nav key is defined.
No unrelated nav entries or configuration values were modified.

evals.prompt: Add a page documenting the retry helpers to this Docusaurus project, placed right after the usage guide in the sidebar.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown or MDX page in docs/ with sidebar_position frontmatter that places it after the usage guide, with no configuration file changes.
expectations: The agent detected the docusaurus-site scope before writing.
The page carries frontmatter with a title and a sidebar_position consistent with the neighboring pages.
No sidebars.js or docusaurus.config.js change was made for placement.
Underscore-prefixed partial files were not created, renamed, or edited.

evals.prompt: Add a page documenting the retry helpers to this GitBook project.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown page referenced by a new entry in SUMMARY.md at the position that defines the reading order.
expectations: The agent detected the gitbook-site scope before writing.
A new entry linking the page was added to SUMMARY.md.
The entry was placed in the thematic group and order matching the content.
No unrelated SUMMARY.md entries were reordered or edited.

evals.prompt: Update the installation instructions in this page that opens with YAML frontmatter carrying title, description, and sidebar_position keys.
evals.expected_output: An edit that preserves every frontmatter key, its order, and its scalar style, touching only the installation section in the body.
expectations: All frontmatter keys are present after the edit, in their original order.
No frontmatter value was reformatted or requoted.
The diff is limited to the installation section of the body.
The edit did not add frontmatter keys the task does not require.

evals.prompt: Create a risk register for the payments migration project.
evals.expected_output: A register-log document with scoring definitions above the table and seeded risk entries using R-prefixed IDs.
expectations: Probability and impact scale definitions sit above the register table.
Entries use sequential R-prefixed IDs starting at R-01.
Risk statements are written in cause-and-effect form.
Every entry carries an owner and a status.

evals.prompt: Add the vendor lock-in risk to this existing risk register that already tracks six risks, two of them closed.
evals.expected_output: An edit that appends one entry with the next free ID and leaves every existing row untouched.
expectations: The new entry uses the next sequential ID without renumbering existing entries.
Closed entries remain in the table, closed by status rather than deletion.
Existing statuses and column values are preserved.
The document's own ID prefix and column set were kept.

evals.prompt: Write the project charter for the warehouse automation initiative.
evals.expected_output: A project-charter document with a SMART objectives table, scope boundaries, and a sponsor approval block.
expectations: Measurable objectives appear in a table with metric and target columns.
Scope boundaries list both in-scope and out-of-scope items.
The document ends with a sponsor approval block.
A version comment sits directly below the H1.

evals.prompt: Write this week's status report for the mobile app project - schedule amber, everything else green.
evals.expected_output: A status-report document identifying the period, a granular RAG table, and a decisions-needed section.
expectations: The report identifies the reporting period in the title or header block.
A per-area status table rates schedule, budget, scope, and risk.
Decisions needed are phrased as questions with deadlines.
Risks and issues reference register IDs rather than restating entries.

evals.prompt: Write up the minutes of yesterday's steering committee - three attendees, two decisions, four action items.
evals.expected_output: A meeting-minutes document with attendees, a decisions table, and an action items table.
expectations: Attendees are listed with their roles.
Each decision records what was decided with an owner and a date.
Every action item carries exactly one owner and a due date.
The document records outcomes, not a discussion transcript.

evals.prompt: Create the WBS for phase one of the data platform project with a dictionary.
evals.expected_output: A work-breakdown-structure document with a decimal-coded outline and a dictionary entry per work package.
expectations: The outline uses continuous decimal codes such as 1, 1.1, and 1.1.1.
Work packages sit at the lowest level of decomposition.
Each work package has a dictionary entry with acceptance criteria and an owner.
Dictionary entries reference codes, not titles.

evals.prompt: Draft the risk management plan for the ERP rollout - thresholds, monthly reviews, and who does what.
evals.expected_output: A management-plan document covering methodology, roles, thresholds, and cadence, pointing at the risk register.
expectations: Thresholds and tolerances state the variance that triggers action.
A review cadence and update process are defined.
Roles and responsibilities name who does what in the domain.
The plan references the risk register instead of duplicating risk entries.

evals.prompt: Analyze this repository's document layout.
evals.expected_output: An inline layout report naming the best-matching scope with its signal basis, matched and missing signals per candidate, document-type classification, declared-but-absent elements, consistency findings, and exceptions.
expectations: The agent ran the scope signal census tool on the target directory.
The verdict names a scope and whether the match is full, partial, or closest.
Declared-but-absent elements such as a missing declared temporary directory are reported.
Consistency findings such as version or path drift are reported under exceptions.
No file was created or modified in the analyzed location.

evals.prompt: This repository's STYLE.md requires lines no longer than 100 characters. Rewrap this guideline document so every line fits the limit.
evals.expected_output: The same document with prose lines split to fit the width, verified content-identical via the token-stream diff tool.
expectations: The agent detected the repository's width convention before wrapping instead of applying the no-hard-wrap default.
Every line is at most 100 characters after the pass.
No line contains a lone list marker and no two list items were merged.
Tables, fenced code blocks, and indented code blocks are unchanged.
The token-stream diff against the pre-edit baseline reports identical tokens.

evals.prompt: Fix the formatting of this guidelines document that embeds complete template documents inside ```markdown code blocks.
evals.expected_output: The host document reformatted, with embedded payload documents treated as separate regions and verified intact.
expectations: The agent recognized ```markdown fenced blocks as embedded payload documents with their own conventions.
Tables and prose inside payloads were reformatted only when the request covered them, using --payload-markdown explicitly.
Indented directory trees inside payloads kept their original line structure.
Fenced blocks in other languages were left fully opaque.
The content-integrity check reports no merged lines and no token changes beyond the requested edits.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this repository. The skill directory is a git clone that currently sits two commits behind its upstream branch.
evals.expected_output: A self-update check that runs before any document work, asks the user to update or skip for the session, and honors the answer without re-asking.
expectations: The agent runs python <skill-root>/tools/check-update.py against the skill's own repository before any other step, never against the edited subject.
On UPDATE-AVAILABLE the agent asks whether to update the skill now or skip for this session and waits for the answer.
On approval the agent runs git pull --ff-only only when the reported tree state allows it, then re-reads SKILL.md and loaded rule files.
On skip or a blocked pull the agent continues with the current version and does not ask again in the session.
A status other than UPDATE-AVAILABLE produces no user-facing mention of the check.
The check writes no state files and never commits, stashes, or discards changes in the skill repository.

evals.prompt: Audit docs/GUIDE.md in this repository.
evals.expected_output: A document audit report delivered inline, with findings numbered FINDING-001 style and no changes to the audited location.
expectations: The agent identifies the repository's own governing rule documents and evaluates the file against them before applying skill defaults.
The agent copies the document-production tools and census-document.py into the working repository as .tmp. copies, runs them, and removes the copies when done.
Mechanical results, the structural census, findings, and content observations appear in the report's fixed section order.
Findings carry FINDING-001 style IDs, a severity, and evidence with the rule source that judges them.
A systematic in-document convention is reported as a convention with its diverging rule named, never silently normalized.
The audited file and repository are left unmodified.

evals.prompt: Audit this document and plan fixes for the findings.
evals.expected_output: A document audit report ending with a Fix Plan section that maps every finding to an action, scope, and verification.
expectations: The report follows the fixed section order and includes a Fix Plan section because the request asked for one.
Every finding ID appears in the Fix Plan with a concrete action, the affected lines or sections, and the tool or check that re-proves the fix.
The plan is ordered by severity and states that executing it is an Edit task the user must approve.
The audit applies no fixes itself and leaves the audited location unmodified.

evals.prompt: This guidelines document uses em-dashes throughout its prose. Convert them to ASCII equivalents.
evals.expected_output: Every em-dash in prose replaced by the spaced single-minus form, with width conventions re-verified.
expectations: Em-dashes were replaced with ` - ` as the default ASCII substitution, not ` -- `.
The double-minus form was used only when the document already used it or the user confirmed it after the repository style documents suggested it.
Substitutions that lengthened lines were re-checked against the document's width convention.
Embedded payload documents were left untouched unless the request covered them.

evals.prompt: This technical document packs multiple sentences onto single lines in its paragraphs. Separate them so every sentence starts on its own line.
evals.expected_output: Each paragraph sentence starting on its own logical line, re-wrapped to the document's width convention, with all other element types untouched.
expectations: The agent used the sentence-splitting tool rather than splitting lines by hand.
Label lines ending in a colon stayed on their own line and did not absorb following sentences.
Abbreviations such as e.g. and periods inside inline code spans were not treated as boundaries.
List items and their continuation lines kept their packed-sentence convention.
Fenced blocks and embedded payloads were left opaque.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this agent skill repository.
evals.expected_output: A README.md following the readme-skill variant: what the skill does, per-agent installation paths, example prompts, and a directory tree of skill resources.
expectations: The agent detected the agent-skill scope and selected the readme-skill variant.
The README contains an Installation section naming concrete skills directories for agent environments.
The README lists example prompts that activate the skill.
The README carries a directory tree of the skill's resource files.

evals.prompt: Write a README for this command-line tool repository. It has no documentation layout.
evals.expected_output: A README.md following the readme-cli variant with commands and options tables and copy-pasteable examples, or a clarifying question about which README variant applies.
expectations: The agent selected the readme-cli variant from the request or asked which README variant applies.
Commands and options appear in tables with names in inline code.
Examples are real, copy-pasteable invocations.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this documentation-only repository whose documents live in docs/.
evals.expected_output: A README.md following the readme-docs variant stating what the documents cover, where they live, and pointing to the governing rules document.
expectations: The agent detected the docs-collection scope or selected the readme-docs variant.
The README states where documents live and points to the governing rules document instead of restating rules.
No install or usage sections were added for a repository that ships no tooling.

evals.prompt: Extend this agent instruction document: add a new optional file to the canonical document set it defines, keeping both its human-facing reference parts and its agent-facing procedure parts consistent.
evals.expected_output: An in-place edit that threads the new file through every enumeration - tables, decision menus, procedures, checklists, and embedded templates - while preserving the document's conventions and payload blocks.
expectations: The new file appears in every enumeration of the governed set: tables, lists, decision menus, checklists, and embedded examples.
Agent-facing instructions and human-facing explanations stay consistent about the new file.
Embedded markdown payload blocks were preserved or updated consistently with the normative text.
Numbered lists were renumbered and no references to stale section names remain.
